svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Saw 60 mm slices off 80 x 40 mm bar: blocks 80 wide x 40 deep x

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 60 tall. The 80 x 60 face without the V is the front.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: V: 120 degrees, centred, 70 mm wide at the back face, its point

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 20.2 mm in from the back. Saw inside the lines, file to them.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Key the V: hacksaw cuts 1 mm deep, 3 mm apart, running the full

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 60 mm height on both V faces. The ridges grip the pole.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Front: a groove 21 mm wide and 1 mm deep across the full width,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: centred on the height, for the band. Mill or file it flat.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Front: two M8 holes on the centre line, 20 mm above and below the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: middle: drill 6.8 mm 18 deep, tap 14 deep.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the pole sits in the V touching both faces (6 mm in from the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: back corners on 114 mm, 20 mm on 60 mm); the band runs round the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: pole and across the saddle's front in the groove.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: on a 114 mm tube the block must not rock.
